title: KeyDeck: Multi-Paper-to-Slide Generation via Cross-Paper Synthesis and Reference-Guided Personalization
abstract: arXiv:2611.33715v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-paper-to-slide generation (multi-PTSG) is the task of constructing a unified presentation from multiple research papers by selecting, organizing, and synthesizing information across sources. This task introduces two main challenges: (i) combining multiple sources into a coherent narrative requires identifying cross-paper relationships and synthesizing their content, and (ii) the desired organization and emphasis varies substantially across presenters, making personalization essential for user satisfaction. Motivated by these challenges, we propose KeyDeck, the first multi-PTSG framework that integrates per-paper and cross-paper analysis to identify relationships among sources and synthesize their contributions into a coherent narrative, and reference-guided personalization to infer presenters' narrative, content, textual, and visual preferences and adapt slide generation accordingly. To evaluate generation quality, personalization

translated_title: KeyDeck：通过跨论文综合与参考引导个性化实现的多篇论文到幻灯片生成
translated_abstract: 多篇论文到幻灯片生成（multi-PTSG）是从多篇研究论文中选择、组织和综合跨来源信息以构建统一演示文稿的任务。该任务带来两个主要挑战：（i）将多个来源组合成连贯的叙述需要识别跨论文关系并综合其内容；（ii）不同的演示者对组织和重点的需求差异很大，因此个性化对于用户满意度至关重要。基于这些挑战，我们提出了KeyDeck，这是首个multi-PTSG框架，它集成了单篇论文分析和跨论文分析来识别来源之间的关系并将其贡献综合成连贯的叙述，并通过参考引导的个性化来推断演示者在叙述、内容、文本和视觉方面的偏好，从而相应地调整幻灯片生成。为了评估生成质量、个性化……
tldr: KeyDeck是首个多篇论文到幻灯片生成框架，通过单篇和跨论文分析将多篇论文的贡献综合成连贯叙述，并利用参考引导的个性化推断演示者的偏好来自适应生成幻灯片。
en_tdlr: KeyDeck is the first multi-paper-to-slide generation framework that identifies cross-paper relationships and synthesizes contributions into a coherent narrative, while employing reference-guided personalization to adapt slide generation to presenters' narrative, content, textual, and visual preferences.
